name: Bloom Lab
desc: A Bloom filter visualizer: bit-array size, hash count and item count sliders drive occupancy and the false-positive rate, checked against theory.
controls: Bit-array, hash-count and item-count sliders, four presets, insert/query/reset buttons; keys 1–4 load presets, I inserts, Q queries, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
